notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h1]Changes/Fixes[/h1]

Hello everyone!
Today we are giving you the following changes/fixes:

[list]
[*] The rope now has a texture!
[*] The Swordfish enemy will no longer get stuck behind ropes and do nothing
[*] Swordfish enemy's hitbox has been smaller and more fair
[*] Some more environmental setdressing has beeen added!
[*] Some minor setdressing fixes
[*] When obtaining an upgrade, it now shows a nice graphic along with it!
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[h1]Thanks to all who played the game![/h1]

Thank you to everyone who has played the game so far, we have loved hearing about how you experienced it so far!
Today we are bringing some minor changes/fixes to the game.

[h1]Changes/Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Music has been added to the intro cinematic
[*] The first Swordfish you encounter has been slightly moved back for a more fair first encounter
[*] Some camera fixes
[*] Flying enemy texture will no longer dissapear when getting hit
[/list]

notes.title: S.P.L.I.C.E.D. Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]OUT NOW AND FREE TO PLAY![/h1]
[b]We are very happy to announce that S.P.L.I.C.E.D. is now officially released! [/b]

This has been a student project that has been worked on for the past year and we're finally happy enough with the game for everyone to be able to play it.
We are very excited to hear what everyone thinks and can't wait to see the reception of everyone.

To manage expectations, we do want to note that because this is a student project, it's unlikely many updates, or any at all, will still be shipped for the game besides minor bug fixes and small changes. Any feedback is however still appreciated as this was a giant learning experience for the entire team.

From all of Fishbait Studios, we hope you enjoy!
